You will see the heading My Daily Journal — Zustand is working! and nothing else. No entries.
No form. No theme toggle. No search.
That is expected. The components are empty shells. The store has some starter state but the components are not connected to it yet.
Have a look through the files before moving on. Get a feel for where things live.
By the end of Chapter 2 the store will be alive and journal entries will be showing on screen.
